graphArtifacts.producerNote: CloudStack is the 9df5dcf3 release extraction, not a new candidate build.
CloudStack is the 9df5dcf3 release result; Eclipse is the earlier development extraction. Query this existing artifact without rerunning extraction.

interpretation: This is a known Java development cohort and no independent holdout.
A relation in the graph is a stored observation, not independently verified source truth.
Unique class ownership is required before class-level attribution; ambiguous and unresolved relations remain explicit.
Cross-language graph/query ability and authored explanations require separate evaluation.
Do not change or rerun Graphify, source repositories or frozen graph producers for this inventory.
outputs: Preserve every class ID and its method/field/relationship coverage counts, aggregate distributions across all classes, relation/evidence totals, all 55 sample joins, ambiguity and limit outcomes, raw graph/source hashes, and repeated verification. Keep prior Graphify/Compass native hub rankings unchanged.

ownership.provenance: Count source-anchor, exact AST, inferred and other evidence separately. Record class-member relation multiplicity and missing endpoints.
ownership.rule: A direct directed typed contains edge from a node of kind class to a node of kind method or field creates an owner candidate. Deduplicate the owner IDs per member. If zero or multiple distinct class owners, member ownership is unavailable or ambiguous; never choose the first.

purpose: Inventory source-backed class ownership and method/field relationships across every class in both frozen Java graphs before designing any responsibility or cohesion score. This is not a defect classifier.

relationships.cohesionLimit: Do not infer low cohesion from methods without field references: extraction coverage and dynamic dispatch may be incomplete. Do not compute TCC, WMC, ATFD or a god-object score from this inventory.
relationships.fieldReferences: For each directed references edge from a uniquely class-owned method to a field node, count own-class, foreign-class and unresolved field targets. Track methods with observed own/foreign field references, distinct targets and exact anchored occurrences.
relationships.methodCalls: For each directed calls edge from a uniquely class-owned method, count distinct internal, foreign and unresolved method targets and exact anchored occurrences. Preserve repeated edge records separately.

samplePolicy: Retain all 55 external Blob reviews; eight consensus primary cases and all 47 secondary cases. Never tune thresholds on the eight known cases or reinterpret missing facts as a negative label.
